bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH SUNDAY AFTERNOON... Combined seas 15 to 17 ft building to 18 to 22 ft late tonight. Bar conditions severe with breakers covering the bar. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 245 AM Saturday, 300 PM Saturday, and 330 AM Sunday. The afternoon ebb will be strong.
bar.conditions: severe with breakers covering the bar
bar.seas: 15 to 17 ft building to 18 to 22 ft late tonight
bar.ebb: The afternoon ebb will be strong
